title: Urgency Queue with a Heap
prompt:
Simulate task scheduling with a priority queue:
- `record Task(String name, int priority)` in `Solution`
- `static List<String> processTasks(List<Task> tasks, int slots)`:
  put all tasks into a `PriorityQueue` ordered by priority ASCENDING
  (1 = most urgent), then poll up to `slots` tasks and return their
  names in processing order.

Same priority → FIFO among equals (use a sequence tiebreaker in the
comparator).

tests.name: most urgent first
tests.hint: Priority 1 first, then 3 — regardless of insertion order.

tests.name: FIFO among equal priorities
tests.hint: Tiebreak by insertion sequence: comparator compares priority, then index.

tests.name: slots caps the output
